descriptions.text: Enchanted Collar Charm of the Effete Bourgeoisie The middle size of the chains of leadership, this pendant signifies you as a member of the elite. Each jewel encrusted upon this charm represents a settlement owned and controlled by the bearer. If one still maintains a settlement's jewel upon the collapse of the level, the holder of this necklace will permanently receive a tax stipend every ten days from that settlement based on size and population. In addition, each gem will impart additional benefits based on the town. In order to upgrade this necklace, one must first conquer an Extra-Large-sized Settlement. Upgraded necklaces will also upgrade all existing gems. …

recap.text: Donut swaps her butterfly charm for the Enchanted Collar Charm of the Effete Bourgeoisie, which she calls ugly because its gem is turquoise, and which she must wear to order the guards about. The gem, Plain Turquoise for Point Mongo, gives plus eight dexterity, plus four intelligence, the Snitch skill and 3,592 gold in taxes every ten days. A gnoll guard examines the charm and lets it go.

beats.headline: The gem is turquoise
beats.text: Donut likes her butterfly charm. It makes fairies like her, it is part of her fit, and stupid Angel the cocker spaniel had four or five tags on her collar. The system only lets a crawler wear so many magical items, Carl says, and the new one is better. It's ugly, says Donut, and the gem is turquoise: does she look like an elderly woman in a bingo hall? She does not need it to rename the Large Ursine Settlement Point Mongo, but to order the guards about she must wear it. One gem, Plain Turquoise, Point Mongo: plus eight dexterity, plus four intelligence, Snitch at level ten, and 3,592 gold in taxes every ten days.
beats.gist: Donut keeps her butterfly charm but must wear the ugly turquoise mayoral charm to order Point Mongo's guards.

beats.headline: Nobody likes a snitch
beats.text: The charm's gem comes with Snitch, a skill rather than a spell. Inside any settlement it alerts all the town's guards, who start moving to her. At level five one guard is teleported to her at once, at level ten it is five, and at ten they can also be summoned up to a kilometer outside a town she owns. There is no cooldown, but the System warns her not to abuse it: these guard guys get really cranky. Donut huffs, mumbles, and changes out the charms.
beats.gist: Donut's charm gem carries Snitch, which summons town guards to her, and the System warns against abuse.

beats.headline: Patted down by gnolls
beats.text: Two gnoll security guards with diver's flippers tied at their waists search Carl and Donut, then leave through a hatch in the ceiling. The one bent over Donut clutches her collar charm and examines it closely. It used to be a butterfly, Donut tells him, but now it's this ugly thing. Ghastly, she knows. He lets it go, declares them clear, and appears to scratch her under the chin on his way out.
beats.gist: Donut's collar charm, once a butterfly, is examined by a gnoll guard before he clears them.

beats.headline: A red gem, and 403 gold
beats.text: A red gem has been added to Donut's leadership charm, for a small-sized settlement. It gives plus two to intelligence, plus one to dexterity and a few points in some spear-throwing skill she will never be able to use, which annoys her, especially since its tax stipend is only 403 gold every ten days.
beats.gist: Donut's charm gets a red gem: small stat bonuses, a useless spear skill, and a 403-gold stipend.
